name: review
title_zh: 截图跑一遍设计评审再跑一遍代码评审，产出修改清单
tagline_zh: 改完 UI 心里没底，又懒得逐行自查？它先给指定路由截图，再让设计评审和代码评审两个角色各写一份问题清单。
tagline_en: After a UI change, it screenshots the given routes, runs a design critic and a code reviewer to each file a fix.
desc_en: 화면을 스크린샷으로 찍고 se-design-critic(디자인)·se-reviewer(코드)로 검토해 수정 목록을 만들고 반영한다. "/se:review [라우트…]"
why_zh: 设计和代码分成两个独立评审角色，各出各的清单，而不是一个模型既夸又改。
why_en: Design and code are two separate reviewer roles filing separate lists, not one model both praising and patching.
limit_zh: 只对能跑起来、能截图的路由生效，得先有可访问的本地或预览环境；纯后端、CLI、无 UI 的改动它无从下手。
limit_en: Needs runnable, screenshot-able routes (local or preview env). No UI, no backend-only or CLI changes. The fix list is advice, not a guarantee.
title_en: Screenshot-driven design + code review that outputs a fix.
